admission.justification: The bounded locator alone, the shared note and first-line naming alone, the ownership and reclamation alone, or the 600-character refusal alone would each leave a launch failing at some depth or leaving a stale alias; together they promise a note that fits at any depth and a locator that always opens the exact bytes.

guarantee: A launch's recovery note and first-message line name one request-owned locator and the exact SHA-256, so the note fits at any report-folder depth and always opens the frozen hand-over bytes; the locator is reused or rebuilt across repeat and resume, refuses a collision before any file is written, and is reclaimed alone when resumability ends.
title: A bounded, request-owned hand-over locator keeps the recovery note at any folder depth
